facts.headline: Proof-of-Liquidity: A Game Changer for DeFi
facts.summary: Proof-of-Liquidity is a blockchain consensus model that ties network security and validation to liquidity provision rather than raw computation or token holdings. It promises deeper, more usable liquidity for DeFi, but raises real questions about manipulation, adoption, and what happens when liquidity itself becomes scarce.
